page.overview:
Who is Derby Boy?

The Derby Boy can be found at the playing field in central Lorule. He runs the Octoball Derby mini-game with the Derby Girl and Octo. He invites Link to try their game at the cost of 50 Rupees. If Link scores at least 100 points in the game, the Derby Boy will reward him with a Piece of Heart.
